  local function _cvm2_run()
    local _s = _cvm2_k[1]
    local _n = _cvm2_k[2]
    local _t = {}
    local _c = string.char
    local _byte = string.byte
    for i = 1, _n do
      local orig = _byte(_cvm2_bc, i)
      -- Bitwise xor simulation portable across all Luau / Lua 5.1 environments
      local x = orig
      local y = _s
      local p = 1
      local res = 0
      while x > 0 or y > 0 do
        local rx = x % 2
        local ry = y % 2
        if rx ~= ry then res = res + p end
        x = (x - rx) / 2
        y = (y - ry) / 2
        p = p * 2
      end
      _t[i] = _c(res)
    end
    local _decoded = table.concat(_t)
    local _fn = (getfenv and getfenv().loadstring or loadstring or load or (function(src)
      return function() end
    end))(_decoded)
    if _fn then
      return _fn()
    end
  end

  _cvm2_run()
end
